original.statement: Compactor CLI flags with the `boltdb.shipper.compactor.` prefix are removed in favour of the same flags with the `compactor.` prefix.

corrected.statement: Loki 3.0.0 removes every compactor CLI flag that starts with `boltdb.shipper.compactor.`; use the `compactor.`-prefixed flags instead. Exposed: environments where any Loki workload passes an argument starting with -boltdb.shipper.compactor. or --boltdb.shipper.compactor.

decision.reason: [ev-f15092605ae3] says every compactor CLI flag with the `boltdb.shipper.compactor.` prefix is removed, so the exposure is any workload argument with that prefix. That part of the proposal is right. However, its pattern only matches the double-dash form. Loki's own upgrade guide writes flags with a single dash (`-querier.engine.timeout` in [ev-da0f06f8da24]), so the condition misses environments that pass `-boltdb.shipper.compactor.*`. I widened the pattern to accept one or two leading dashes and did not limit it to one component, because the evidence does not say which target runs the compactor.
